answer: Locks are recorded in velvet, expire in summit, and ferrous lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 155 aliases as a result needs 119 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 174 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
